name: Zichri
overview: The name Zichri appears multiple times in Scripture, identifying several individuals across different tribes and roles. He is noted as a son of Izhar among the Levites (Exodus 6:21), and as a Levite himself connected to the lineage of Asaph (1 Chronicles 9:15). Additionally, Zichri is mentioned as a Benjamite in multiple genealogies (1 Chronicles 8:19, 23, 27), and as a father to notable descendants such as Amasiah, Elishaphat, and Joel, highlighting his role in leadership during the days of David (1 Chronicles 26:25). These references collectively demonstrate Zichri's diverse presence in Israel's tribal and priestly history, emphasizing God's providential care in preserving faithful leaders and priests within His covenant people.
